actions.signature_quote: The number is real. What people infer from it is not my problem.
actions.access_rule: An honest weigh is the price of anything at Stallrow. Contest a true reading without cause and the exchange stays open but remembers you.

actions.signature_quote: Read it twice. I'll say it twice. After the second time there is only the ink.
actions.access_rule: Help is real, against a plainly named forfeit. The forfeit is never abstract. Sign, negotiate the term, or decline — no hidden clause survives a second reading.

actions.signature_quote: There is a document now. People argue with it instead of with each other.
actions.access_rule: Sign the draft and you are on the record. Perrin will not pass a clause he knows is unfair — but he has not yet noticed every clause that is.
